data.long_meaning: Nooralam is a Hindi name that means 'Light of the land'. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'nir', meaning 'light', and 'oora', meaning 'land'. This name is believed to be bestowed upon those who illuminate and bring prosperity to their communities and homelands. The name Nooralam carries the meaning “Light of the land” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Parents who choose Nooralam usually hope their child will grow to embody light of the land and live with faith, good character and purpose.
